predictions.text: I predict that the Rapid Support Forces will launch another drone strike against a water source in North Kordofan.
I predict that the Colombian conflict will continue with another drone strike by the end of Monday, 16 November 2026, targeting a military base in Bolívar Department.
I predict that the Houthi–Saudi conflict will continue with Saudi airstrikes hitting residential areas in Yemen, resulting in at least 30 casualties by the end of Monday, 16 November 2026.

I predict that the investigation into the El Ayyat train collision will find that signaling systems and track maintenance standards are inadequate and require immediate attention, with similar accidents occurring in at least one other country by the end of November 16, 2026, including one in Egypt.
I predict that student protesters across France will continue their demonstrations with about 146,000 participants.

I predict that a prominent political figure secures sufficient support from a major political group to form a coalition government, but fails to reach the necessary number of seats by the end of Monday, 16 November 2026, leaving Israel without a clear majority government.
I predict that the first court hearing for the shooter will be held in Kraków, Poland, by the end of Monday, 16 November 2026.
I predict that the National Party will have the most seats in the House of Representatives by the end of Monday, 16 November 2026, with more than the Labour Party.
I predict that Canada wins the 2026 IIHF Women's World Championship against Denmark in the final on 16 November 2026.
I predict that the final match of the 2026 ACC Under-19 Asia Cup will be between Afghanistan and Sri Lanka, with Afghanistan winning by 6 wickets.
